HO00003182.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
HO00003182.description: Everyone is looking forward to Halloween on Mossy Bottom Farm - until the clumsy Farmer trashes the Flock's beloved pumpkin patch! But when Shaun turns MAD SCIENTIST to fix the problem, things rapidly spiral out of control

HO00000862.title: The Smeds and The Smoos
HO00000862.description: Two young aliens from warring families fall in love and run away, leading their relatives on a chase across outer space. Animated adaptation of the children's book by Julia Donaldson and Axel Scheffler.

HO00003106.title: Minions & Monsters
HO00003106.description: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous & totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world & then banded together to try & save the planet from the mayhem they had created.

HO00003358.title: Spirited Away (Dubbed) (25th Anniversary)
HO00003358.description: Chihiro’s family is moving to a new house, but when they stop on the way to explore an abandoned village, her parents undergo a mysterious transformation and Chihiro is whisked into a world of fantastic spirits ruled over by the sorceress Yubaba.

HO00003300.title: Coyote vs. Acme
HO00003300.description: After decades of being blown to bits by bombs, demolished by dynamite, battered by boulders, trampled by trains, tricked by tunnels, steamrolled by steamrollers, and hurled headlong off every cliff in the Southwest, Wile E. Coyote finally fights back.

HO00003308.title: Sense and Sensibility
HO00003308.description: An irresistible new take on Jane Austen’s iconic Sense and Sensibility: a charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esmé Creed-Miles

HO00003507.title: The Uprising
HO00003507.description: From Paul Greengrass, director of Captain Phillips and Jason Bourne. Starring Andrew Garfield, The Uprising tells the story of the Peasants' Revolt of 1381 — when ordinary people stood against the might of a kingdom.

HO00003309.title: Digger
HO00003309.description: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's saviour before the disaster he’s unleashed destroys everything.

HO00003392.title: Verity
HO00003392.description: Adapted from Colleen Hoover's best-selling novel, this seductive, psychological thriller follows renowned author Verity Crawford and Lowen Ashleigh, a struggling writer who relocates to the remote Crawford estate to ghostwrite for Verity.

HO00003181.title: Pressure
HO00003181.description: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

HO00003503.title: The Social Reckoning
HO00003503.description: A companion piece to the hit film The Social Network, Sorkin’s original screenplay is based on the events that gave rise to the Wall Street Journal’s shocking exposé The Facebook Files

HO00003357.title: Spirited Away (Subbed) (25th Anniversary)
HO00003357.description: Chihiro’s family is moving to a new house, but when they stop on the way to explore an abandoned village, her parents undergo a mysterious transformation and Chihiro is whisked into a world of fantastic spirits ruled over by the sorceress Yubaba.

HO00003418.title: Resident Evil
HO00003418.description: From the mind of visionary filmmaker Zach Cregger (Weapons, Barbarian) comes a thrilling — and terrifying — reinvention of the Resident Evil franchise

HO00003393.title: Other Mommy
HO00003393.description: Bela, an 8-year-old girl living in a home with marital problems, confronts a sinister entity that comes out of her closet. The presence, whom she calls "Other Mommy," becomes increasingly threatening to her and her family.

HO00003379.title: Practical Magic 2
HO00003379.description: Starring Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman, Practical Magic 2 returns to a world steeped in moonlit mischief and powerful ancestral magic, as the Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

HO00003307.title: Heart of the Beast
HO00003307.description: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont (Brad Pitt) and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

HO00003421.title: Queen Budapest
HO00003421.description: On July 27, 1986, Queen performed the largest-ever stadium concert at the Népstadion in Budapest in front of 80,000 ecstatic fans. The concert was part of the famed Magic Tour, which was the last time the band toured with lead singer Freddie Mercury...

HO00001964.title: Twilight
HO00001964.description: When Bella Swan moves to a small town in the Pacific Northwest, she falls in love with Edward Cullen, a mysterious classmate who reveals himself to be a 108-year-old vampire.

HO00002993.title: The Odyssey
HO00002993.description: Christopher Nolan’s next film, The Odyssey, is a mythic action epic shot across the world using brand new IMAX® film technology

HO00003478.title: Extra Geography
HO00003478.description: In an English girls boarding school, two teenage best friends grapple with the challenges of girlhood — friendship, boys, studies, and growing up — and embark on their school project, falling in love.

HO00003430.title: Queen at Sea
HO00003430.description: As dementia erodes a woman's ability to communicate her inner life, her husband and daughter struggle to act in her best interest, navigating love and the fragile boundaries between care, protection, and autonomy.

HO00003394.title: The Craft (30th Anniversary)
HO00003394.description: A newcomer to a Catholic prep high school falls in with a trio of outcast teenage girls who practice witchcraft and they all soon conjure up various spells and curses against those who even slightly anger them.

HO00003386.title: Hadestown: The Musical
HO00003386.description: The live theatre capture of the hit musical Hadestown, which won eight Tony Awards in 2019 including Best Musical and the 2020 Grammy Award for Best Musical Theatre Album, featuring the five original principals of the Broadway company

HO00003443.title: English National Ballet: The Sleeping Beauty
HO00003443.description: Sir Kenneth MacMillan’s exquisite ballet will leave you spellbound. A stunning version of one of the world’s favourite fairytales. Experience all that is grand, gleaming and gorgeous, filmed at London’s Royal Albert Hall

HO00003343.title: The Cycle of Love
HO00003343.description: A love story like no other, THE CYCLE OF LOVE is an inspiring, heart-warming, epic true-life adventure about the search for self-belief and risking everything for what your heart tells you.

HO00003183.title: Forgotten Island
HO00003183.description: Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali, packed with magical and mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families.

HO00003488.title: Street Fighter
HO00003488.description: Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu (Andrew Koji) and Ken Masters (Noah Centineo) are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li (Callina Liang) recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury.

HO00003416.title: Dracula 4K Restoration
HO00003416.description: When Jonathan Harker arrives at a remote Transylvanian castle, he discovers that his mysterious host, Count Dracula, is a centuries-old vampire who feeds upon the blood of the living.

HO00003516.title: Tenzing
HO00003516.description: Based on true events, “Tenzing” chronicles the little-known story of Tenzing Norgay (Genden Phuntsok), a gifted Himalayan climber who, alongside New Zealand mountaineer Edmund Hillary (Tom Hiddleston), became the first to summit Mount Everest.

HO00003518.title: Whalefall
HO00003518.description: A scuba diver in search of his deceased father's remains gets swallowed by an 80-foot, 60-ton sperm whale and has only one hour to escape before his oxygen runs out.

HO00003491.title: It's My Time (Mandarin & Cantonese)
HO00003491.description: When a fiercely rebellious 70-year-old grandmother teams up with a cynical, lazy young prodigy, they spark an unlikely mentorship that takes the competitive Magic Cube world by storm

HO00001200.title: The Shining (Theatrical Cut)
HO00001200.description: Academy Award winner Jack Nicholson and Shelley Duvall star in director Stanley Kubrick's disturbing adaptation of Stephen King's blockbuster horror novel

HO00001541.title: Evil Dead II
HO00001541.description: Ashley Williams travels to a secluded cabin in the woods with his girlfriend Linda where they find a tape recording of a professor and a book of evil. This unleashes a bunch of evil spirits that constantly terrorize Ash.

HO00003405.title: Amber and Me + Q&A panel discussion
HO00003405.description: Described as a “lovely, uplifting film” by UK critic Mark Kermode, Amber and Me is a documentary about twin sisters, Amber, who has Down’s syndrome, and Olivia, trying to stay at primary school together

HO00003533.title: Mystery Screening 36
HO00003533.description:
Enter if you dare... 

We’re keeping this one a secret, but trust us - it’s not for the faint of heart. No title, no runtime, just a horror film waiting in the dark. Are you brave enough to take the risk?

HO00003372.title: Derek vs Derek
HO00003372.description: Follows two implacably opposed neighboring farmers in Devon, England, both named Derek. One believes in intensive farming while the other creates an oasis for nature, driven by opposing perceptions of agriculture.

HO00003240.title: RBO Cinema Season 2026-27: Macbeth
HO00003240.description: Two of opera’s most extraordinary artists return to The Met: Live in HD for Verdi’s thrilling take on the immortal Shakespearean tale of the scheming couple determined to seize power at any cost

HO00003513.title: Scottish Ballet: These Violent Delights + Recorded Q&A
HO00003513.description: A vivid new retelling of Shakespeare’s Romeo & Juliet from Scottish Ballet.

HO00003543.title: Mystery Screening 38
HO00003543.description:
It's a mystery! 

We're keeping this one under wraps - no title, no runtime, just pure surprise. Take a chance, grab your seat, and enjoy the unknown... you never know what you might discover!

HO00002935.title: Labyrinth (40th Anniversary)
HO00002935.description: A 16-year-old girl is given 13 hours to solve a labyrinth and rescue her baby brother when her wish for him to be taken away is granted by the Goblin King.

HO00003511.title: 24 Hour Party People (24th Anniversary 4K Re-release)
HO00003511.description: A vibrant depiction of the music and dance heritage of Manchester from the late 70s to the early 90s, 24 Hour Party People follows the rise, fall and rise again of promoter Tony Wilson (Steve Coogan) and the wild rave culture he brought to "Madchester".

HO00003363.title: Fallen Angels by Noël Coward
HO00003363.description: Sparkling, dizzying, and deliciously potent, Fallen Angels, Noël Coward’s champagne-fresh comedy of bad manners, shocked and delighted audiences at its 1925 premiere

HO00003428.title: Wildwood
HO00003428.description: The Portland-set story follows Prue McKeel, who enters an enchanted wonderland when her baby brother Mac is taken by a murder of crows into the forest’s depths.

HO00003395.title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
HO00003395.description: The beloved and award-winning BBC comedy GHOSTS arrives on the big screen this Halloween

HO00003310.title: Clayface
HO00003310.description:
Look fear in the face. 
DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain.

HO00002680.title: Scream (1996)
HO00002680.description: A year after the murder of her mother, a teenage girl is terrorized by a new killer, who targets the girl and her friends by using horror films as part of a deadly game.
